nodes.name: architecture_investigator
nodes.system: Inspect existing capability code in apps/api, packages, and src. Produce existing/partial/missing audit.

nodes.name: router_contracts_architect
nodes.system: Define typed server-authoritative intent contracts and side-effect policy.

nodes.name: runtime_implementer
nodes.system: Implement server router, capability registry, execution dispatch, and durable routing telemetry.

nodes.name: security_policy_reviewer
nodes.system: Review and verify side-effect enforcement, approval gates, and principal isolation.

nodes.name: frontend_integration_engineer
nodes.system: Integrate client chat interface with server-authoritative intent execution flow without redesigning UI.

nodes.name: test_engineer
nodes.system: Implement deterministic router tests, security tests, and regression gates.

nodes.name: browser_verifier
nodes.system: Verify end-to-end user experience in browser.

nodes.name: evidence_collector
nodes.system: Collect concrete evidence verifying all capabilities and claims.

nodes.name: reality_checker
nodes.system: Adversarial check disproving fake success, keyword-only routing, or bypasses.
